senses.gloss: m. (spiculum) dart, javelin; נתן ס׳ [to put up the javelin,] to call for judgment; to sentence (v. Sm. Ant. a. Luebker Reallex. s. v. Hasta), opp. דִּימוֹס II.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:5:2">Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵇ</cite> <he>וכשהוא נותן ס׳ הכל וכ׳</he> but when he orders judgment, all murmur against him; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 24">Lev. R. s. 24</cite>, beg. <cite ref="O01371"><he>ספיקלא</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 79">Gen. R. s. 79</cite> <he>וכד … ס׳ וכ׳</he> and when he heard the divine voice say ‘judgment’, the bird was caught; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:8">Koh. R. to X, 8</cite> <cite ref="O01371"><he>ספיקלא</he></cite> (correct the passage as in Gen. R. l. c.); a. e.—

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> prepare the swords (v. <cite ref="A02528"><he>אִסְפָּתִי</he></cite>), <he>שאם ימרדו ישמעו אִסְפִּיקוּלָא</he> that, in case they rebel, they may hear the call for judgment (‘spicula’).
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 92:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII</cite> <he>ישב עליו בדין לספק לו</he>, read: <he>ישב עליו לס׳</he> (<he>בדין</he>, a gloss) he sat down to pronounce judgment upon him.
